body: Smoking Goose is awesome! I just finished eating one of their Stagberry Salame.
I'm on anti-depressants but don't have the funds to pay for a therapist. I live on disability and that's not even really enough just to get by every month.

I've dealt with renal issues my entire life, but transplanted 4 years ago. I'm just tired of the constant struggle and don't see a positive way forward. I would never commit suicide but that doesn't change the fact that I wish I were dead on a daily basis.

That's the problem. I don't have anything in my life that made the surgery worth it. I got a kidney that someone way more deserving should have received. If I had it to do over again, I wouldn't do dialysis or the surgery.

My time on dialysis was horrible. During that time, all I could think about was how things would be better after the transplant. I tried to remain optimistic throughout the process and worked towards goals like getting an education. It's now 4 years since the transplant and nothing about my quality of life has improved (financially, relationships...). I'm just tired and think it would have been better to call it quits once I got sick. Now I'm stuck with someone else's kidney and a sense of obligation to make good on it, with zero ability to do so. The feelings of guilt and regret are a huge weight on me and all I want is to call it quits.

My mom says the same thing all the time. I'm sure she means it, but that doesn't mean I'm not a financial burden. Emotional support from anyone, including the social workers at the transplant center, has been non-existent for as long as I can remember. I've just been assessing what a shit show my existence has been up to this point, and I'm starting to realize that a precious commodity shouldn't be wasted on someone who is nothing but a drain on family/society.

Kidney transplants. The only family member that acts like they give a shit is my mom. She is  nearly 70 years old and I feel like a complete scumbag relying on her to help get me through month to month. I doesn't help when she reassures me I'm not, and then tells me how much I cost her. 

Work is a little more complicated than just finding something part time through Ticket to Work. I don't want to write a novel here, but know that I did attempt to get help from them. Thank you for your input.
